title: Cookies and privacy choices
html:
Fitzgerald Enterprises LLC uses browser storage on fernwork.zeabur.app to keep a cart together and to remember recently viewed items. No advertising or cross-site tracking cookies are set on this store, so there is little to opt out of beyond ordinary browser settings.

What is stored

Cart and recently viewed are kept in your browser's local storage, not sent to us, and persist until you clear them or they age out. The browser session cookie keeps a single visit coherent.

Changing a choice

Clearing site data in your browser removes both. If you clear storage or switch devices you may need to rebuild your cart. Our handling of browser privacy signals, including Global Privacy Control, is limited because no advertising scripts run.

Email PumpCadle668@outlook.com if you need help exercising a privacy choice. The Privacy notice explains how we use order information.
